source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors occur in roughly 10% of individuals with NF1, often arise from preexisting plexiform or atypical neurofibromas, and are the leading cause of death for people with NF1.
notes: Full text (PMC9629420, HTML). Statement made by the de Blank 2022 review citing Evans 2002 (PMID 12011145, ref 46) and Duong 2011 (PMID 21542925, ref 47).
